title: Roadmap Conductor: sprint patterns and guardrails for Private Tenancy
creator: Marina Chen
description:
Context: As Private/VPC/on‑prem customers scale, we need a deterministic quarterly runway to coordinate compatibility gates, operational readiness, and customer activation windows. Current planning is ad hoc across teams which increases upgrade friction and risks missed SLAs.

Objective: Define a 'Roadmap Conductor' pattern — a set of sprint rhythms, guardrails, and artifact templates that product, engineering, design, and ops can use to plan and execute Private tenancy features across a quarterly cadence. The pattern should reduce cross-team handoff time by 30% and shrink release rollback events related to compatibility by 50% within two quarters.

Approach: 1) Create canonical sprint templates (design reviews, infra freeze, tenant compatibility window, canary cohort schedule). 2) Specify staging and certification gates (compat matrix, automated integration smoke, performance SLO signoff). 3) Define stakeholder roles and RACI for each runway phase. 4) Produce checklists and dashboard signals (upgrade health, error budget, cost delta). 5) Pilot with two upcoming Private features and iterate.

Deliverables: roadmap-conductor playbook, sprint template repo, Confluence PRD, preflight automation checklist, dashboard panels, and a pilot retro.

Success metrics: Time-to-canary reduced by 30%, private upgrade failures <= 1% per activation cohort, cross-team planning meetings reduced by 20% for participating initiatives.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook published in Confluence with step-by-step sprint template
Two pilot features run using the templates and complete canary without rollback
Certification gate automated for basic compatibility checks (smoke + perf) integrated into CI
Dashboards show upgrade health and error budget for pilot cohorts
Stakeholder sign-off from Eng, Security, and Customer Success
